not_client_data: Synthetic demonstration data, generated by CreditProbe v5 from the synthetic books. It describes no real company, family, group, person or relationship.
label: Synthetic data

dictionary.group_id: Connected-group id: the book's group id (CG####) for a group the book already holds as a handful of companies, otherwise <book group id>-<nnn> for one carved out of an artefact mega-group.
dictionary.legacy_group_id: The book's own group_id for this borrower. Every new group sits inside exactly one.
dictionary.role: parent (holds the group), subsidiary (owned above 50%) or affiliate (owned 20% to 49.5%) in a group; owner, chairman, director or CEO for a person; head, spouse or dependant in a household.
dictionary.ownership_pct: Share of the target held by the source (group edges) or by the person (owner role), per cent.
dictionary.rel_type: GROUP (ownership), SUPPLIES (source sells to target), GUARANTEES (source guarantees target's facility), SHARES_COLLATERAL (both claim one pledged asset).
dictionary.purchase_share_pct: Share of the buyer's purchases that this supplier provides, per cent.
dictionary.revenue_share_pct: Share of the supplier's revenue sold to this buyer, per cent (at most 60).
dictionary.annual_value_sar_mn: Annual value of the supply, SAR million: the buyer's purchases times the share.
dictionary.guarantee_amount_sar_mn: The book's own Corporate Guarantee collateral value on the facility, SAR million.
dictionary.claim_sar_mn: The value one borrower claims against a shared asset, SAR million.
dictionary.allocation_pct: Claim as a share of the asset's market value, per cent. Above 100 across the claimants means the asset is over-pledged.
dictionary.household_id: A retail household: customers living together.
dictionary.employer_borrower_id: The corporate borrower that employs the retail customer.
